- N1 - The nitrogen of a ring
- C(=O) - Another carbonyl in the ring
- c2ccccc2 - A phenyl ring
- S1(=O)=O - A sulfur with two oxygens (sulfone), closing back to N1

This looks like a benzothiazine dioxide derivative with a benzoyl group on the nitrogen. Specifically, it appears to be N-(4-fluorobenzoyl)-1,1-dioxido-1,2-benzothiazin-3-one or similar.
